canonical_name: evomerge -- Evolutionary Optimization of Model Merging Recipes (authors: 'Sakana AI' per pyproject.toml; no author names in README/CITATION; Sakana AI; 2024)
lineage: README: source models for the merges are shisa-gamma-7b-v1, WizardMath-7B-V1.1, GAIR/Abel-7B-002, Arithmo2-Mistral-7B, LLaVA-1.6-Mistral-7B; EvoLLM-JP-v1-10B is built from EvoLLM-JP-v1-7B + shisa-gamma-7b-v1. 'Our math evaluation code builds on the WizardMath repository.' evomerge/utils.py functions 'copied from https://github.com/Stability-AI/generative-models'. Vendored heron/video_blip modules carry HuggingFace/Salesforce headers. Compared against lm-eval-harness jp-stable branch (Stability-AI). || main loop (reader, from the code): evaluate.py loads a config, instantiates one model wrapper, then for each evaluator config instantiates the evaluator, calls evaluator(model) to generate answers over a HuggingFace dataset and score them, and dumps all metrics to a JSON file; there is NO evolutionary search, merging (no CMA-ES, DARE, TIES, SLERP, layer-stacking) or optimisation code anywhere in the tree -- the repo is evaluation-only, and the evolved weights are consumed as pre-built HuggingFace checkpoints.

entry_points: evaluate.py main (loads a YAML config, instantiates a model wrapper and one or more evaluators via evomerge.instantiate_from_config, runs each evaluator on the model, writes results/<config>.json)
evomerge/utils.py instantiate_from_config / get_obj_from_str (dotted-path 'target' + 'params' object factory, copied from Stability-AI generative-models)
evomerge/eval/ja_mgsm.py JaMGSM (loads juletxara/mgsm ja test split, prompts the model, extracts a numeric answer, computes acc and fasttext-gated acc_ja)
evomerge/eval/ja_vg_vqa.py JaVGVQA and evomerge/eval/ja_vlm_wild.py JaVLMBenchIntheWild (load SakanaAI VQA datasets, batch through the VLM, ROUGE-L via evomerge/eval/utils.py evaluate)
evomerge/eval/metrics.py rouge_ja / MecabTokenizer / LanguageDetector (Japanese ROUGE with MeCab tokenisation; fasttext language ID)
evomerge/models/causallm.py CausalLMWithvLLM (vLLM-backed text generation with a prompt template and stop tokens)
evomerge/models/llava.py LLaVA, evomerge/models/heron_v1.py HeronV1, evomerge/models/jsvlm.py JSVLM (VLM inference wrappers)

example.input: A YAML config such as configs/llm/evollm-v1-jp-7b.yaml: model.target evomerge.CausalLMWithvLLM with model_path SakanaAI/EvoLLM-JP-v1-7B, template ja-alpaca-cot; eval.target evomerge.eval.JaMGSM
example.output: results/<config-name>.json containing per-evaluator metrics (e.g. acc, acc_ja for MGSM-JA; ROUGE-L for the VQA benchmarks) and per-example question/answer/response/prediction lists; README reports e.g. EvoLLM-JP-v1-7B MGSM-JA acc 52.0
